final: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DECIMAL(5,2)) / rental_duration) AS fee_per_duration FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(fee_per_duration) AS overall_fee_per_duration FROM rating_stats), filtered_ratings AS (SELECT rs.avg_replacement_cost, rs.fee_per_duration, oa.overall_fee_per_duration FROM rating_stats rs JOIN overall_avg oa ON 1=1 WHERE rs.fee_per_duration > oa.overall_fee_per_duration) SELECT AVG(avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(fee_per_duration) AS avg_fee_per_duration, AVG(fee_per_duration - overall_fee_per_duration) AS avg_difference FROM filtered_ratings
